PNK · WIOO

Serving Pontianak, located in Kubu Raya Regency.

The Directorate General of Civil Aviation profile checked on 19 October 2026 places Supadio in Limbung, Sungai Raya, Kubu Raya Regency, West Kalimantan, with IATA PNK, ICAO WIOO and operator PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia. It lists international use; that status does not guarantee an international route on a particular date.

Official regulator profile ↗

Operating hours have not been confirmed.

Google Maps did not list hours, a telephone or an operator website when checked. This guide does not retain the old hours claim or infer 24-hour operation from popularity charts. Confirm terminal access and service times with your airline and official channels.

New terminal: a record from 28 December 2017.

The State Secretariat reports the new terminal’s inauguration on 28 December 2017 and mentions Dayak ornamentation. This is historical context, not a guarantee of today’s layout, capacity or facilities. The Air Force’s Sungai Durian history concerns the air base and does not grant access to military areas.

Terminal inauguration archive ↗

For departures and arrivals, use airline channels.

Flight status

Check your flight number, date, status, terminal and gate with the airline and airport displays. This guide does not provide a live flight feed.

Check-in & baggage

Follow the airline’s check-in deadlines, documents, baggage rules and assistance process. No single arrival lead time applies to every journey.

Meeting passengers

Confirm pick-up zones and arrival timing. A location pin does not permit stopping in a particular lane or entering restricted areas.

Confirm ground transport before travelling.

From Pontianak or elsewhere

Ask your provider about the route, pick-up point, fare, payment method and time allowance. This guide does not guarantee a journey duration or particular road approach.

Taxi, rental or app-based vehicle

Check which services are actually available and the pick-up-zone rules on your travel date. Do not assume all providers can collect passengers at the same door.

Bus, shuttle & parking

Confirm the operator, route, schedule, boarding point and charges. The regulator lists overnight parking, but this does not guarantee spaces, tariffs or staffing today.

A facility listing does not guarantee a service is operating.

The regulator profile lists ATMs, car rental, medical facilities, a Port Health Office, overnight parking and restaurants. Confirm locations, hours, costs, accessibility and special assistance with the airline/operator. Toilets, prayer rooms, charging, fuel and other needs also require their own checks; do not assume every service is always available.

Plan city visits separately from your airport journey.

For onward visits in Pontianak or Kubu Raya, check each destination’s address, hours, costs and access separately. This guide does not confirm sightseeing paths, accommodation facilities, vehicle charging or combined tickets. Allow time according to your flight and confirm return transport.

Two sources use different address wording.

Google Maps on 19 October 2026: Jl. Arteri Supadio No. Km. 17, Limbung, Sungai Raya, Kubu Raya, West Kalimantan 78391. Hubud writes Jl. Adisucipto KM17 Pontianak 78381. Both refer to Supadio; confirm your terminal entrance and destination point rather than relying only on a postcode. The map pin -0.1476038, 109.4052887 is visitor orientation, not the airport’s technical ARP coordinate.

Questions before travelling

What is the Supadio Airport code?

Hubud lists IATA PNK and ICAO WIOO. Match the name, code, date and journey details with your airline ticket.

Where is Supadio Airport?

The airport is in Limbung, Sungai Raya, Kubu Raya Regency, West Kalimantan, serving the Pontianak area. Maps and Hubud use different road/postcode wording; confirm the correct terminal and drop-off or pick-up point.

Is the airport open 24 hours?

Google Maps did not list hours when checked on 19 October 2026. This guide guarantees no fixed hours or night access. Confirm terminal access and service times with the operator and airline.

Where can I check flight status?

Use your flight number and date with airline channels and official airport displays. This guide does not provide live departures, arrivals or gate information.

Are international flights available?

The regulator profile lists international use, but that does not confirm a particular route, airline or timetable is active. Check availability and travel requirements directly with the airline.

What do travel and terminal access cost?

Air tickets, transport, parking and other services have separate terms. This guide guarantees no fare, sightseeing ticket, free access or permission to enter a particular area.

Are taxis or buses always available?

No service or timetable is guaranteed here. Confirm the operator, boarding location, pick-up zone, price and backup option for your travel date.

Are facilities and special assistance available?

The regulator lists several facility categories. Confirm operating services, locations, hours and wheelchair or assistance needs with the airline/operator before travelling.

Is this Supadio Airport’s official website?

No. It is an independent visitor guide without affiliation to the airport operator, airlines or government and provides no tickets or bookings.
